items: *Mr. Khal:* Thank you very much.
*The Secretary:* You are welcome…
*Mr. Joyner:* Come in …
*Mr. Khal:* Good morning, Mr. Joyner.
*Mr. Joyner:* Sit down, please.
*Mr. Khal:* Thanks.
*Mr. Joyner:* Did you bring your background and the application form for the job?
*Mr. Khal:* Sure. It’s right here.
*Mr. Joyner:* Good! Let’s see… Well. Are you really interested in that position, Mr. Khal?
*Mr. Khal:* Yes, I am. It could give me the opportunity to acquire new experience and get into a new market.
*Mr. Joyner:* Well, but remember that if you get the job, you must work hard.
*Mr. Khal:* I know that Mr. Joyner, but I don’t mind about it because I’m trying to be the best sales manager in the future.
*Mr. Joyner:* Is that what you expect? Don’t worry about our plans to expand the company to many other cities in the world.
*Mr. Khal:* Sure. And if you allow me to take that position, I will travel to South America as soon as possible and send you a monthly report of the business there. What do you think about it?
*Mr. Joyner:* I think that you must wait for a couple of days. I’ll talk to the General Manager this afternoon. In fact, I have been waiting for a person like you, Mr. Khal.
*Mr. Khal:* Thank you. When can I start working?
*Mr. Joyner:* Let me talk to Mr. Gerstel this afternoon. In the meantime, you have a good chance to be incorporated in our company.
*Mr. Khal:* Well, I’ll come back here whenever you want, Mr. Joyner.
*Mr. Joyner:* My secretary will call you. Let me take you to the door, Mr. Khal.
*Mr. Khal:* Thank you. Good-bye, Mr. Joyner.
*Mr. Joyner:* Good-bye.
*Morela:* Have you talked to Mr. Khal?
*Ira:* No, Is he the new manager?
*Morela:* Yes, he is. I met him yesterday afternoon.
*Ira:* I couldn’t meet him. I was very busy here and I haven’t had any chance to go to Mr. Joyner’s office.
*Morela:* Take your time! You’ll see him everyday from now until July when he leaves to South America. By the way, how is Fabiola, your baby?
*Ira:* Oh! She’s fine. She will be a terrible girl. You know, she’s only seven months and she wants to talk.
*Morela:* That’s good.
*Ira:* Well, let me check some informs now. See you later. All right?
*Morela:* O.K. See you later.

items.q: Is Mr. Khal interested in the job?
Does he have to work hard if he gets the job?
What will Mr. Khal send to Mr. Joyner monthly?
